pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. One single MONTH calendar panel, blank binding header and an orderly grid of SEVEN columns and FIVE rows of blank day cells, with ONE bold red outer frame and one red arrow pointing to the ENTIRE month panel. All day cells white, no specific day highlighted. Represent one whole MONTH. NO writing, day names, month names, letters, dates or digits. Entire object inside frame with ample white margin, no people. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
